title: Consequences of Performance-Enhancing Misconduct: Insights from Professional Road Cycling, 2000–2010
authors: Christopher B. Yenkey; Donald A. Palmer
main_or_robustness: not applicable (panel logit of career interruption)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: random-effects panel logit (xtlogit, odds ratios) of yearly career interruption on doping-incident indicators/categories with many time-varying controls; nonlinear, no unit FE
count or categorical teammate-doping exposure in RE logit with controls
RE logit with counts of riders' doping incidents and controls

eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Rider-year and manager-year panels (2000-2010) model the probability of career interruption (stopout) with random-effects logit on contemporaneous doping-incident indicators, counts and categories plus performance, age, team-tier and tenure controls and year FE. Exposure is not an absorbing staggered adoption and the models are nonlinear.

data_provenance_note: Compiled from public cycling and doping sources.
screener_notes: Published PDF text checked for table titles (Tables 4-6: discrete-time event history estimates; no DiD). Empty regression inventory because the code is shipped as a .txt file. Clear exclusion.
